rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a single static image, but it overstates confidence about expansion/zona status and describes TE as fitting B-grade when the provided lab grade is AB and the image itself does not clearly support all those details.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, prior miscarriage, tubal factor, endometrium, BMI, sperm parameters, and embryo stage/grade into prognosis and counseling.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, with a plausible prognosis tied mainly to age-related aneuploidy risk; minor issues include some imprecision around morphology terminology and extrapolation from limited image data.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and guideline-based counseling, including SET preference, hydrosalpinx/cavity review, luteal support, and selective discussion of PGT-A; minor deviations include some loose wording around Gardner staging and a few speculative points.

Provides practical next steps for transfer optimization and future cycle review, including uterine/tubal assessment, luteal support, protocol/trigger review, and selective further workup, though some suggestions remain somewhat general rather than highly case-specific.
